text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having gained a new perspective from her new rivals, Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan, Nice Nature enters the Takarazuka Kinen well-prepared.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She swears to win for those who support her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With this positive mindset, Nice Nature challenges the Takarazuka Kinen.
